comment: Intentional, documented differences between the native frame trace and the original traces in Extermination/build/s87/frame_trace/ (tools/compare_frame_order.py; SCENE_COORDINATOR_DESIGN.md section 3.3). Each entry: id, kind (missing = an original event the native side may lack; extra = a native event the original lacks; field = a per-frame field that may differ, only 'classifier'), traces (original names or '*'), event pattern (any of op/fn/target/callback/record; addresses as hex) or field, reason (with evidence), removed_by (the WP-n or Sn step that deletes the entry). The list must only shrink: add an entry only in the step that introduces the documented difference.

entries.reason: While walking, 0015BCF0 (0x15BDD8) -> 00187350 -> 00187EE0 -> 001EFD90(0x80000028) -> 001EF9D0 appends a footstep effect node (callback 001EA240, +0xD 5) about every 23 frames (ORIGINAL_FRAME_ORDER.md section 6, Q4). The port's player stage has no 00187EE0 effect spawn, so its pool never holds the node.
